시편 75:1.content: To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, A Psalm or Song of Asaph. Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

시편 75:2.content: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

시편 75:3.content: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

시편 75:4.content: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

시편 75:5.content: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

시편 75:6.content: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

시편 75:7.content: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

시편 75:8.content: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

시편 75:9.content: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

시편 75:10.content: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
